title: How to Grow Out a Buzz Cut or Fade Without the Awkward Stage
hero_alt: Side profile of a man in a black turtleneck with a grown-out buzz cut
image_plan: pexels: man short hair growing out
card_text: Keep cleaning the sides while the top catches up. How a buzz or fade grows out stage by stage without a puffy month.
lede: To grow out a buzz cut or fade without the awkward stage, let the top grow but keep cleaning up the sides and back. The awkward look comes from everything growing at once, so the head goes round and puffy. When the sides stay tidy while the top catches up, every stage looks like a short haircut on purpose, and you can move from a buzz to a crop to something longer without a bad month.
Here's why the awkward stage happens, what each stage looks like, and what gets cut along the way.

blocks.heading: Everything grows at once.
blocks.lead: And the sides show it first.
paragraphs: Hair grows at roughly the same rate all over the head, about half an inch a month. The problem is where that shows. On the sides, an extra half inch sticks out and makes the head look wide. On top, the same half inch barely registers.
Leave everything alone and the sides get puffy and swallow the ears long before the top has enough length to do anything. That's the awkward stage.

blocks.heading: Top grows, sides stay tidy.
blocks.lead: One instruction covers most of it.
paragraphs: Each time you sit down, tell me you're growing it out. The top gets left alone or barely touched, while the sides, back and neckline are cleaned up. The gap between top and sides widens a little each visit, which is exactly what makes it look like a style.
The sides don't have to be skin-short. A taper with more length works fine, and the sides can grow slowly too, just never faster than the top.
The back of the neck matters too. A clean neckline is the one detail that keeps a grow-out from looking neglected, even when the top is at its least cooperative.

subsections.heading: Fuzz
paragraphs: The first stretch after a buzz or skin fade. The top looks like a slightly longer buzz. Keep the edges neat and it simply reads as short hair.

subsections.heading: Short crop
paragraphs: With an inch or so on top, push it forward. Over tidy sides, this is basically a textured crop, and it's one of the easiest stages to wear.

subsections.heading: The in-between
paragraphs: At a couple of inches, hair starts falling in different directions. Picking one, forward, back or to the side, and sticking with it makes this stage far easier.

subsections.heading: Length
paragraphs: From here you choose: keep the sides short for contrast, or start letting them grow to match the top for a longer, softer shape.

blocks.heading: Small habits that help.
paragraphs: A few things make the in-between easier:
bullets: Don't trim the top yourself to even it out. It undoes the growing.
Push the top the same way every day so it learns where to fall.
A hat is fine for rough days. It won't slow anything down.
Take a photo on a day you like it, so you can show it at the next visit.

blocks.heading: Back to short is allowed.
paragraphs: If you get halfway and miss the buzz, it takes one appointment to go back. My buzz cut page shows the short end of things.
Grow-out visits are booked as an Essential Haircut, {{price:essential-haircut}} for {{minutes:essential-haircut}}, with a straight razor neck cleanup that keeps the back tidy at every stage.

items.q: How do I grow out a buzz cut without it looking bad?
items.a: Keep cleaning up the sides and back while the top grows, so it always looks like a short cut on purpose.

items.q: How long does it take to grow out a buzz cut?
items.a: Hair grows about half an inch a month, so it depends on the length you're after. A short crop comes much sooner than a longer style.

items.q: Should I cut my sides while growing my hair out?
items.a: Yes, at least early on. Tidy sides are what get you past the awkward stage.

items.q: How do I grow out a fade?
items.a: The same way: let the top grow, soften the fade a little each time, and keep the neckline clean.
